note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 (independent auditor). Row: RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 Established, Event 24/25/18 list. c987777bb8 changed TestRFC4271ConnectRetryCounterOnVersionErrorPerState in its doc comment only (the Event 24 clause in Connect/Active now said to sit in the DelayOpenTimer-is-not-running branch the timer-disabled crcFSM fixture exercises); the body is unchanged and still requires counter exactly 1 and Idle after NotifMsgVerErr in Connect, Active and Established, while the negative requires OpenSent and OpenConfirm to leave the counter at 0. Peer-level units unchanged: NOTIFICATION 2/1 (Event 24), Cease (Event 25) and far-end close (Event 18) in Established each raise peer-down, drop the session, stop the timers and move the counter 0 -> 1; KEEPALIVE plus a valid UPDATE keep the session (negative). Routes clause: TestRFC4760PeerDownDeletesOnlyThatNeighborsRoutes deletes that neighbor's routes and keeps a bystander's; the dispatcher translation from reactor peer-down to the RIB event is not asserted end to end. Correction to the previous note: fsm Timers.StartConnectRetryTimer now has production callers (b6d84e8104: Connect Event 18 with a running DelayOpenTimer, Active Event 18), and FSM.change stops the ConnectRetryTimer on every Idle entry except Active Event 18; the peer-level 'ConnectRetryTimer not running' assertion therefore guards a reachable timer, not only a future one. Tagged units ran green 2026-10-31 under -race. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
